note: Two-column recto body page, 1750x2180 px (ratio 0.803, not A4). body_text_size_px=20 (cap-to-baseline; prose line pitch 36 px). ONE UNCERTAINTY, the same kind as p025-p027: block 4 is a single paragraph that runs across the column break -- its first nine lines sit in the LEFT column and its last thirteen lines ('angular momentum of the electron - a vector quantity...') open the RIGHT column. I put n=4 on the left-column region and n=null on the right-column continuation region rather than repeat the same n twice; that null paragraph is the tail of block 4, not an unmatched block. The subshell chart (n=2) has TWO fills: a lavender label COLUMN #e0deef down its left side (not a header row) and peach data cells #ffe4b8. I report the peach fill on the table element, which covers the whole bordered chart, and emit the lavender label column immediately after as a nested unnumbered tinted box, so neither colour is lost; those two regions therefore overlap by design. The 'Orbit, orbital and its importance' box (n=9, pale green #cbe7d3) spans the full measure across both columns, hence column 'full'; its dark green #00a550 top rule (y 0.6606-0.6633) and bottom rule (y 0.9101-0.9128) are the box's own borders, folded into its bbox -- they are NOT a rule_bar (that role belongs only to the chapter-opening divider) and not a footer_rule. Its centred bold title is emitted as a nested unnumbered section_heading although the text is part of block 9. Box body type is distinctly smaller than the body prose (30.5 px leading vs 36 px), hence size_rel 0.85. No page_header_band, rule_bar or footer_rule on this page: furniture is the running head (page number 56 left, CHEMISTRY right) and the centred '2024-25' footer line, labelled running_header because it is a running footer rather than the page number. A diagonal '(C) NCERT not to be republished' watermark crosses both columns; not emitted as an element.
